approved.reasoning: Correction against CA7-JTR's order of 50 unit for RM 450 dated 2026-09-08 (s140). Sets total from 450 to 430, delivery from unset to 15, cash from 450 to 430, handover from collected to delivered, cost from unset to 350. It moves no cash and no stock: it changes what the row says about itself. The row is not rewritten here. The fold applies the patch, so there is one definition of what a correction does rather than two.
flags: This row carries a trail of 2 steps. Setting the figure directly does not rewrite them, so the trail will no longer add up to it; the correction is recorded beside them saying so.
A cost typed here overrides what the inventory says this row drew, and it is what every margin on the row is then measured against.
CA7-JTR typically pays about RM 11/unit for oil across 2 orders; this one is RM 8.6, 21.8% below that.
RM 430 for the goods is RM 6.43 under the floor of RM 436.43, which is what the order costs to take out: the goods after the leak, with nothing above them.
RM 450 is paid on an order of RM 430: RM 20 more than it is worth. Check the figures.
The corrected total of RM 430 is under the RM 450 already paid against this row.
